whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hello Restaurant & Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has incredible 4.8★ reviews from over 5,300 customers on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile web page for online table bookings and menu viewing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location guide integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/hellorestaurant

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Hello Restaurant & Cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu showcase and direct WhatsApp table booking for your Boring Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
